dream_growth.grows_from: the waking sun at about 15:56-16:00 GMT, the same leaf-broken light as the elm shade on the bank (LGT-riverbank-01)
dream_growth.how: The high afternoon sun broken into dapples by a closed canopy, as it falls on the sleeping girl under the elms. Cool green shade reads as safety after the house.

schemes.key: WSW sun filtered through a closed oak canopy into scattered hard-edged sun-flecks
schemes.direction_note: flecks fall slanting from the WSW side; backlit leaves and bracken glow when the camera looks toward the sun

fill.note: soft, cool, green-tinted shade light from the canopy and undergrowth

schemes.atmosphere: warm, still shade; dust and bits of dry leaf thrown up by the bounding puppy hang in the sun-shafts
schemes.prompt_fragment_en: Dappled woodland afternoon light: a high sun from the west-south-west breaks through a closed green oak canopy into scattered hard-edged sun-flecks on the leaf litter, the towering grass and the great purple-flowered thistle, backlit leaves and bracken glowing translucent green, the shade itself soft, cool and green-tinted, dust hanging in thin sun-shafts; bright pockets against cool shade, sheltered, breathless-relief mood.
schemes.reason: The wood and thistle are explicit (ch004-p34..p38) but no light is described. The dapple follows environment daylight_access canopy_dappled and the waking-clock sun (environment S01).
